source.title: Mapzen Terrain Tiles / SRTM multi-HGT regional source
source.attribution: Mapzen; SRTM data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey
source.temporalScope: modern geographic elevation reference; not a 1949 terrain reconstruction

derivation.method: direct cross-tile bilinear sampling from native HGT tiles; B is not an upsample of the 196x100 Gate A runtime asset
derivation.sourceSampleInterpolation: bilinear across tile boundaries; nodata clamped to sea level; elevation values retained in metres
derivation.runtimeLandMask: High-resolution OpenStreetMap polygon mask is rendered independently from the DEM grid; no grid-step coastline is used.
derivation.coastlineResolution: 2048x1184 runtime alpha mask from regional OSM vector coastline
